# frontend

> Production client code for web, iOS, and Android surfaces. Installs as an agent skill.

frontend turns "build this" into a controlled implementation instead of an improvised one. It covers
the production frontend surface — component and state architecture, forms and auth flows, the full
state set in code, accessibility, performance, client security, testing, i18n, and consuming a design
handoff — across React, Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, and React Native. The
SKILL.md is a faceted router: one primary job, at most one platform overlay (native overrides web),
a web stack overlay only when the project names or uses that stack, read those references fully,
then ship production code with the full state set and the tests that guard it. Claude Code is the
reference host; it's plain Agent Skills format (agentskills.io), so it installs on Codex, Cursor,
Antigravity, opencode, Grok Build, and Hermes too.

## Install

- npm/skills.sh: `npx skills add gabros20/frontend-skill`
- Clone + installer (per-host targets: claude | codex | cursor | antigravity | opencode | grok | hermes | agents | all): `git clone https://github.com/gabros20/frontend-skill && cd frontend-skill && ./install.sh codex`
- Manual copy: `cp -R skills/frontend ~/.claude/skills/frontend`

## Docs

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabros20/frontend-skill/main/README.md): overview, install, the routing model, repo map.
- [skills/frontend/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabros20/frontend-skill/main/skills/frontend/SKILL.md): the runtime router, universal invariants, artifact contract, and completion rules.
- [docs/installation.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabros20/frontend-skill/main/docs/installation.md): step-by-step installation and verification.
- [docs/usage.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabros20/frontend-skill/main/docs/usage.md): the routing model, activation boundary, and outputs.
- [docs/recipes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabros20/frontend-skill/main/docs/recipes.md): representative starting prompts for common engineering jobs.

## Reference inventory (`skills/frontend/references/`)

Primary job:

- `state-and-data.md` — model client, server, URL, or form state; wire data fetching, caching, mutations, optimistic updates, retries, client auth-flow shape.
- `state-completeness.md` — cover every state a UI can be in — loading, empty, error, success, recovery, notifications, undo.
- `forms.md` — build or fix a form — validation timing, submission, input types, error association.
- `accessibility.md` — ARIA patterns, focus management, semantic HTML, keyboard support, canonical contrast/target/reduced-motion floors.
- `performance.md` — Core Web Vitals, bundle/code-split, images, fonts, rendering cost.
- `client-security.md` — token storage, XSS sinks, CSP consumption, client-reachable-is-public.
- `testing.md` — client tests and the dev-loop self-check — unit/component/UI, coverage, screenshot verification.
- `i18n.md` — logical properties, Intl APIs, direction/language, text-expansion resilience.
- `design-handoff-and-tokens.md` — consume handoff.yaml and DESIGN.md, wire tokens, dark mode.
- `client-architecture.md` — structure or restructure a client codebase — folders, feature boundaries, import discipline, token file layout.

Platform overlay — web substrate (add at most one platform overlay; native overrides web):

- `web-platform-css.md` — modern CSS layout and content-driven breakpoints.
- `web-platform-runtime.md` — SPA routing, storage, service workers, gestures, Safari/viewport hardening, real-time transport, View Transitions.
- `css-craft.md` — scrollbar/overscroll/grid craft-level polish (supplementary, add alongside the web row).
- `js-dom-craft.md` — vanilla DOM and browser-API mechanics (supplementary, add alongside the web row).

Platform overlay — native cluster:

- `swiftui.md` — native iOS / iPadOS, SwiftUI/HIG conformance.
- `swift-concurrency-and-testing.md` — Swift concurrency correctness and Swift Testing, added when async or tests are involved.
- `compose.md` — native Android, Material 3 conformance.
- `kotlin-and-compose-state.md` — Kotlin doctrine and Compose state/recomposition, added when state, coroutines, or Flow are involved.
- `react-native.md` — React Native as the cross-platform stack under the native mandate.

Web stack overlay (only when the platform is web and the project names or uses the stack):

- `react-components-and-state.md` — composition, hook discipline, you-might-not-need-effect, dependency correctness.
- `react-rendering-and-rsc.md` — memo-defeat family, RSC serialization boundary, hydration, code-split shape.
- `nextjs.md` — file conventions, RSC/server actions, caching model, image/font/link primitives.
- `data-fetching-libraries.md` — TanStack Query, SWR, React Router data APIs, TanStack Start.
- `tailwind.md` — v4 `@theme` canonical (v3 compat), `cn`/twMerge/CVA, the postcss trap.
- `shadcn.md` — registry/CLI/ownership model, composition recipes, official-library selection, icon discipline.

Sources:

- `SOURCES.md` — trace a technique to its source.
